tmdb_overview: In 1943, six disparate souls are sent on a secret government mission to produce pornographic propaganda films for the boys on the front, each one struggling under the weight of their own conscience in this war-torn world, and it's not about to get any easier.

synopsis: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. tmdb_overview: Richard Avedon’s photographs didn’t just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. The feature documentary AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used fashion, portraiture, and commercial photography to explore identity, power, fear and beauty. With unprecedented access to Avedon’s archive, including never before seen photos, behind the scenes recordings, and interviews with those who knew him best, AVEDON is a visually stunning examination of the mind of an artist who shaped our collective image of the 20th century.

The Director's Cut of Kingdom of Heaven is widely considered by critics and film enthusiasts to be a masterpiece that completely transforms and saves the original movie. Directed by Ridley Scott and released in late 2005, this version adds 45 to 50 minutes of crucial footage, removed due to fears of large runtime, back into the film, extending the runtime to 3 hours and 14 minutes. course of action: a lawsuit. Securing the services of ambulance-chasing
attorney Kevin Avery (Will Forte), the pair have to take on Acme’s hotshot

years after being shelved as a tax write-off by its studio, this madcap mix of
animation and live-action is seeing the light of day at long last, presenting
the world of Looney Tunes as you’ve never seen it before.

synopsis:
Pressure 
Genre(s): DramaUK/France/USA | 2026 | 100 minsDirector: Anthony Maras Stars: Andrew Scott, Brendan Fraser, Kerry Condon Our Thursday 22nd Oct 2pm screening contains captioned subtitles for those with hearing loss and a post-screening discussion facilitated by the Croydon u3a Film Group. Anyone is welcome to stay behind for a fun chat.Pressure tells the
remarkable untold story behind one of the most important decisions of the
Second World War. In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, Britain’s chief
meteorological officer, Captain James Stagg (Scott), must convince Allied
commanders, including General Eisenhower (Fraser), whether the weather will
allow the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history to proceed.
With the fate of millions hanging in the balance, this is a fascinating look at
the people, decisions and the uncertainty that helped shape the course of
history. Gripping, intelligent and led by a stellar cast.
tmdb_overview: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

The Dashwood sisters, sensible Elinor and passionate Marianne, learn that their prospects of marriage seem doomed by their family's sudden loss of fortune. After Henry Dashwood dies unexpectedly, his estate must pass on by law to his son. These circumstances leave Mr. Dashwood's wife and daughters without a home and with barely enough money to live on. As Elinor and Marianne struggle to find romantic fulfillment in a society obsessed with financial and social status, they must learn to mix sense with sensibility in their dealings with both money and men.

In the Georgian mountains, t wo female cable car operators fall in love as they pass each other in their gondolas.
tmdb_overview: In the Georgian mountains, a cable car connects a village with a smaller town in the valley. Iva started working for the cable car as a conductor and is now in charge of handling the gondolas. While one gondola goes up to the village, the other goes down to the valley. Halfway down, the gondolas meet every half hour. This is exactly the moment when Iva and Nina, the conductor of the other gondola, meet each time. Where at the beginning only collegial greetings were exchanged, over time a flirtation develops. What follows is the big love and stress with the boss.

tmdb_overview: June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom.

synopsis: A struggling actor with a partially paralyzed face and a speech impediment writes a script that a big movie studio wants to buy, but he refuses to sell it unless he gets to play the lead. Turning down an offer of life-changing money, he instead works for pennies to get the movie made with himself in the starring role. The movie becomes the biggest box office hit of 1976, notching ten Oscar nominations and winning Best Picture. The true story of the making of the iconic movie Rocky.
tmdb_overview: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

synopsis: LA BOLA NEGRA tells the story of three men whose lives are intimately connected through desire, pain and inheritance, across three different eras – 1932, 1937 and 2017. Rich with Lorca's poetry and suffused with desire, grief and hope, it is an intimate love story and a sweeping exploration of memory, inheritance and queer history, honouring those whose lives and loves were too often forced into silence.
tmdb_overview: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

synopsis: A struggling actor with a partially paralyzed face and a speech impediment writes a script that a big movie studio wants to buy, but he refuses to sell it unless he gets to play the lead. tmdb_overview: 93-year-old documentarian Chris Hesse—personal cinematographer to forgotten African icon Kwame Nkrumah—races against blindness and time to rescue and repatriate a secret trove of over 1,300 films that captured the birth of African independence in the fifties and sixties. Yet unseen by the public, these films may not only rewrite Ghanaian and African history—but world history itself.

A true love letter to cinema, THE EYES OF GHANA follows 93-year-old cameraman Chris Hesse, as he races against time to rescue a secret trove of film reels that uniquely captured the birth of African independence. Back in the 1950s and 1960s, Hesse was the personal cameraman to Ghana’s revolutionary leader Kwame Nkrumah. Always at Nkrumah's side and always filming, Hesse was witness to Africa’s tumultuous liberation movement. In 1966, Nkrumah was deposed in a coup and his rivals sought to destroy
tmdb_overview: 93-year-old documentarian Chris Hesse—personal cinematographer to forgotten African icon Kwame Nkrumah—races against blindness and time to rescue and repatriate a secret trove of over 1,300 films that captured the birth of African independence in the fifties and sixties. Yet unseen by the public, these films may not only rewrite Ghanaian and African history—but world history itself.

synopsis: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.

synopsis: Look fear in the face. DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain. “Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.
tmdb_overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

synopsis: Richard Avedon's photographs shaped our image-driven world. This film explores his life and legacy through never-before-seen archives, footage, and interviews, revealing how his vision transformed 20th-century visual culture.
tmdb_overview: Richard Avedon’s photographs didn’t just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. The feature documentary AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used fashion, portraiture, and commercial photography to explore identity, power, fear and beauty. With unprecedented access to Avedon’s archive, including never before seen photos, behind the scenes recordings, and interviews with those who knew him best, AVEDON is a visually stunning examination of the mind of an artist who shaped our collective image of the 20th century.

synopsis: A struggling actor with a partially paralyzed face and a speech impediment writes a script that a big movie studio wants to buy, but he refuses to sell it unless he gets to play the lead. Turning down an offer of life-changing money, he instead works for pennies to get the movie made with himself in the starring role. The movie becomes the biggest box office hit of 1976, notching ten Oscar nominations and winning Best Picture. The true story of the making of the iconic movie Rocky.
tmdb_overview: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

synopsis: Look fear in the face. DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain. “Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.
tmdb_overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

synopsis: Filmed over ten years, ONE IN A MILLION follows one girl’s epic journey from Syria to Germany and back again. As she settles into life in Germany, new freedoms collide with the stabilising pull of Szyrian traditions, testing bonds and reshaping her sense of self. tmdb_overview: Filmed over 10 years, one girl's epic journey from Syria to Germany and back again. She and her family navigate war, exile, and heartbreak in a foreign land, illuminating the complexities of the refugee experience.

synopsis: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians.
tmdb_overview: In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel's calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them.

synopsis: Look fear in the face. DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain. “Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.
tmdb_overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

synopsis: LA BOLA NEGRA tells the story of three men whose lives are intimately connected through desire, pain and inheritance, across three different eras – 1932, 1937 and 2017. Rich with Lorca's poetry and suffused with desire, grief and hope, it is an intimate love story and a sweeping exploration of memory, inheritance and queer history, honouring those whose lives and loves were too often forced into silence.
tmdb_overview: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

synopsis: A struggling actor with a partially paralyzed face and a speech impediment writes a script that a big movie studio wants to buy, but he refuses to sell it unless he gets to play the lead. Turning down an offer of life-changing money, he instead works for pennies to get the movie made with himself in the starring role. The movie becomes the biggest box office hit of 1976, notching ten Oscar nominations and winning Best Picture. The true story of the making of the iconic movie Rocky.

Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

tmdb_overview: Richard Avedon's photographs didn't just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. As their teenagers grow closer to a neighbouring family, tensions begin to escalate when their tight-knit new community starts to question their rigid beliefs. tmdb_overview: Following the deaths of Mihai's parents, Mihai and Lisbeth Gheorghiu leave their life behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbeth's family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth gives them hope for a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghiu family’s young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.

tmdb_overview: 93-year-old documentarian Chris Hesse—personal cinematographer to forgotten African icon Kwame Nkrumah—races against blindness and time to rescue and repatriate a secret trove of over 1,300 films that captured the birth of African independence in the fifties and sixties. Yet unseen by the public, these films may not only rewrite Ghanaian and African history—but world history itself.

synopsis: Richard Avedon's photographs shaped our image-driven world. This film explores his life and legacy through never-before-seen archives, footage, and interviews, revealing how his vision transformed 20th-century visual culture.

synopsis: A true love letter to cinema, THE EYES OF GHANA follows 93-year-old cameraman Chris Hesse, as he races against time to rescue a secret trove of film reels that uniquely captured the birth of African independence. Back in the 1950s and 1960s, Hesse was the personal cameraman to Ghana’s revolutionary leader Kwame Nkrumah. Always at Nkrumah's side and always filming, Hesse was witness to Africa’s tumultuous liberation movement. In 1966, Nkrumah was deposed in a coup and his rivals sought to destroy
tmdb_overview: 93-year-old documentarian Chris Hesse—personal cinematographer to forgotten African icon Kwame Nkrumah—races against blindness and time to rescue and repatriate a secret trove of over 1,300 films that captured the birth of African independence in the fifties and sixties. Yet unseen by the public, these films may not only rewrite Ghanaian and African history—but world history itself.

tmdb_overview: Richard Avedon's photographs didn't just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. synopsis: Richard Avedon's photographs shaped our image-driven world. This film explores his life and legacy through never-before-seen archives, footage, and interviews, revealing how his vision transformed 20th-century visual culture.
tmdb_overview: Richard Avedon’s photographs didn’t just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. The feature documentary AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used fashion, portraiture, and commercial photography to explore identity, power, fear and beauty. With unprecedented access to Avedon’s archive, including never before seen photos, behind the scenes recordings, and interviews with those who knew him best, AVEDON is a visually stunning examination of the mind of an artist who shaped our collective image of the 20th century.

synopsis: A true love letter to cinema, THE EYES OF GHANA follows 93-year-old cameraman Chris Hesse, as he races against time to rescue a secret trove of film reels that uniquely captured the birth of African independence. Back in the 1950s and 1960s, Hesse was the personal cameraman to Ghana’s revolutionary leader Kwame Nkrumah. Always at Nkrumah's side and always filming, Hesse was witness to Africa’s tumultuous liberation movement. In 1966, Nkrumah was deposed in a coup and his rivals sought to destroy
tmdb_overview: 93-year-old documentarian Chris Hesse—personal cinematographer to forgotten African icon Kwame Nkrumah—races against blindness and time to rescue and repatriate a secret trove of over 1,300 films that captured the birth of African independence in the fifties and sixties. Yet unseen by the public, these films may not only rewrite Ghanaian and African history—but world history itself.

tmdb_overview: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

synopsis: Set in 1973, during the US’s attempt to overthrow the Chilean government, a hitman for the US government with connections to the JFK assassination suddenly realizes that his own people have put a hit on him to cover up the mess.
tmdb_overview: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

synopsis: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.

synopsis: A struggling actor with a partially paralyzed face and a speech impediment writes a script that a big movie studio wants to buy, but he refuses to sell it unless he gets to play the lead. Turning down an offer of life-changing money, he instead works for pennies to get the movie made with himself in the starring role. The movie becomes the biggest box office hit of 1976, notching ten Oscar nominations and winning Best Picture. The true story of the making of the iconic movie Rocky.
tmdb_overview: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

synopsis: Look fear in the face. DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain. “Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.
tmdb_overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

tmdb_overview: Richard Avedon's photographs didn't just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. The feature documentary AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used fashion, portraiture, and commercial photography to explore identity, power, fear and beauty. It stars Channing Tatum and Gemma Chan as the parents of eight-year-old J
tmdb_overview: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice and a way to feel safe again.

synopsis: A Norwegian woman (Renate Reinsve) and her devout Romanian husband (Sebastian Stan) relocate with their five children to a remote coastal town. As their teenagers grow closer to a neighbouring family, tensions begin to escalate when their tight-knit new community starts to question their rigid beliefs. Soon, the parents are forced to counter accusations that could tear their household apart – and battle a system that blurs the line between concern and prejudice. Captivatingly led by Academy Awar
tmdb_overview: Following the deaths of Mihai's parents, Mihai and Lisbeth Gheorghiu leave their life behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbeth's family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth gives them hope for a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghiu family’s young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.

synopsis: When Russia shuts down all independent media, a group of young dissident journalists must flee Moscow so they can keep reporting and not go to prison. tmdb_title: My Undesirable Friends: Part II - Exile
tmdb_original_title: My Undesirable Friends: Part II - Exile
tmdb_overview: A group of Russian independent journalists flee the country and navigate life in exile after the invasion of Ukraine, focusing on their dispersed lives and ongoing struggle for truth across different nations. While Part I documented their lives in Moscow facing mounting pressure from the Putin regime, Part II chronicles their forced displacement and new realities in various countries, continuing their mission against authoritarianism.

tmdb_overview: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice and a way to feel safe again.

synopsis: A Norwegian woman (Renate Reinsve) and her devout Romanian husband (Sebastian Stan) relocate with their five children to a remote coastal town. As their teenagers grow closer to a neighbouring family, tensions begin to escalate when their tight-knit new community starts to question their rigid beliefs. Soon, the parents are forced to counter accusations that could tear their household apart – and battle a system that blurs the line between concern and prejudice. Captivatingly led by Academy Awar
tmdb_overview: Following the deaths of Mihai's parents, Mihai and Lisbeth Gheorghiu leave their life behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbeth's family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth gives them hope for a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghiu family’s young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.

synopsis: A true love letter to cinema, THE EYES OF GHANA follows 93-year-old cameraman Chris Hesse, as he races against time to rescue a secret trove of film reels that uniquely captured the birth of African independence. Back in the 1950s and 1960s, Hesse was the personal cameraman to Ghana’s revolutionary leader Kwame Nkrumah. Always at Nkrumah's side and always filming, Hesse was witness to Africa’s tumultuous liberation movement. In 1966, Nkrumah was deposed in a coup and his rivals sought to destroy
tmdb_overview: 93-year-old documentarian Chris Hesse—personal cinematographer to forgotten African icon Kwame Nkrumah—races against blindness and time to rescue and repatriate a secret trove of over 1,300 films that captured the birth of African independence in the fifties and sixties. Yet unseen by the public, these films may not only rewrite Ghanaian and African history—but world history itself.

movie_title: Maverick: The Epic Adventures of David Lean
movie_title_en: Maverick: The Epic Adventures of David Lean
synopsis: David Lean was one of the greatest film directors of all time. He redefined what movies could be, but his singular vision and dogged determination to film the impossible gained him the reputation of being an obsessive maverick. He was a master of his art, able to create love and beauty on screen, but whose own life was often messy, rootless, and painful. An in-depth study of the man and his films. Narrated by Cate Blanchett, Kenneth Branagh is the voice of Lean, featuring interviews with Wes And
tmdb_title: Maverick: The Epic Adventures of David Lean
tmdb_original_title: Maverick: The Epic Adventures of David Lean
tmdb_overview: Profiles the double Oscar winner, who helmed some of the most well-respected movies of all time, via never-before-seen archive and contributions from leading film directors. Haunted by the shadow of his dismissive father and his puritan upbringing, Lean was married six times, and he created layered and complex narratives in his work while struggling to find connection and meaning in his personal life.

GIANT, the 5-star critically acclaimed play starring John Lithgow (Killers of the Flower Moon, The Crown) as Roald Dahl, comes to the big screen. Winner of 3 Olivier Awards® including Best Play and a Tony Award® for Best Actor in a Play (John Lithgow), the production was filmed live in London’s West End ahead of its sold-out Broadway run. The stellar cast includes Aya Cash (The Boys, The Franchise, You’re the Worst), Elliot Levey (Cold War, Patriots, Good) and Rachael Stirling (The Divine Mrs S)
tmdb_overview: Set in the summer of 1983, just before the release of The Witches, Giant imagines a tense meeting between Roald Dahl and his American and British publishers as they scramble to contain the fallout from his public denunciation of Israel and defence of the Palestinians in a review of a book on the 1982 Lebanon war. Filmed live onstage at the Harold Pinter Theatre in London's West End in 2025.

But the vice principal Van Vlad hosts a particular dislike for humans, and Mia is scared he has seen through her act...

synopsis: A construction worker pockets an invitation and follows it through an unmarked door. Beyond it lies Bijou: a mysterious theatre where watching becomes participation and the ordinary city opens into a maze of private fantasy.Wakefield Poole uses colour, music and dreamlike cutting to push adult filmmaking towards the avant-garde. Dialogue falls away, theatrical spaces dissolve and desire becomes a way of seeing. A landmark of independent queer cinema whose restless visual imagination reaches far

A teahouse erupts. A warehouse becomes a battlefield. Then a hospital turns into an action sequence that seems determined to test the limits of cinema itself. Inspector Tequila and an undercover cop are on the same side—if they can survive long enough to prove it.Chow Yun-fat and Tony Leung give John Woo’s gunplay epic its bruised romantic core. The choreography is astonishing, but the real charge comes from loyalty, compromised identities and bodies moving through physical space at impossible s
tmdb_overview: A cop who loses his partner in a shoot-out with gun smugglers goes on a mission to catch them. In order to get closer to the leaders of the ring he joins forces with an undercover cop who's working as a gangster hitman. They use all means of excessive force to find them.

synopsis: One night in the Yabba should be enough. But a lost bet strands a schoolteacher in an outback town where hospitality means another drink, another dare and another reason he cannot leave.Ted Kotcheff turns sunshine and friendliness into instruments of terror. Gary Bond’s careful composure is stripped away by a community whose rituals of masculinity are both welcoming and merciless, with Donald Pleasence an unforgettable guide into the abyss. A sun-blasted nightmare of drinking, belonging and the
tmdb_overview: A young schoolteacher descends into personal moral degradation after finding himself stranded in a brutal, menacing town in outback Australia.

synopsis: Their marriage is already a war zone. Picking up a stranger gives it an armed third party. A bitter couple’s journey across the American West becomes a savage contest over stolen money, control and who will get out alive.Franco Nero, Corinne Cléry and David Hess form a combustible triangle in Pasquale Festa Campanile’s sun-baked road thriller. Ennio Morricone’s score gives the landscape a seductive pulse while the cramped caravan becomes increasingly poisonous. An exploitation film whose most un
tmdb_overview: A bickering couple driving cross-country through California pick up a psychotic hitchhiker with two million dollars who threatens to kill them unless they take him to Mexico.

synopsis: Something enormous is stirring beneath the California surf. As swimmers and sailors vanish, a reporter and a marine expert uncover a threat with eight arms, an appetite for tourists and no respect for the summer season.John Huston, Shelley Winters and Henry Fonda lend improbable Hollywood grandeur to this gloriously wayward Italian creature feature. Ovidio G. Assonitis answers JAWS with a giant octopus, sunlit coastal menace and Stelvio Cipriani’s irresistible score: aquatic exploitation with a
tmdb_overview: Several people disappear from and at the sea. Their bodies are found gnawed to the skeleton, even the marrow is missing. The scientists have no idea which animal could do such things. Dr. Turner begins to suspect that the company which builds a tunnel beneath the bay might have poisoned the environment and caused an octopus to mutate to giant dimensions...

movie_title: THE RED QUEEN KILLS SEVEN TIMES
movie_title_en: THE RED QUEEN KILLS SEVEN TIMES
synopsis: A family curse says the Red Queen returns every hundred years to take seven lives. When a crimson-cloaked killer begins stalking the people around a fashion-house heiress, old rivalries and a disputed inheritance make the legend horribly useful.Barbara Bouchet and Marina Malfatti lead Emilio P. Miraglia’s sumptuous collision of Gothic mystery and couture-world giallo. Bruno Nicolai’s score slips beneath images of castles, cameras and lethal elegance. Every gorgeous surface conceals another motiv
tmdb_title: The Red Queen Kills Seven Times
tmdb_original_title: La dama rossa uccide sette volte
tmdb_overview: After the death of their grandfather, two sisters inherit their family castle, which is said to be haunted by the Red Queen, whom legend says claims seven lives every hundred years.  When a mysterious woman in a red cloak starts targeting their circle of friends, the sisters begin to suspect there might be some truth to the legend.

synopsis: Fashion designer by day, China Blue by night: Joanna Crane has built two lives to keep desire at a manageable distance. A private investigator and a deranged preacher are about to tear down the partition.Kathleen Turner and Anthony Perkins go gloriously for broke in Ken Russell’s neon psychosexual fever dream. Pop-art colour, outrageous religious imagery and Rick Wakeman’s electronic score turn an erotic thriller into a furious comedy of repression and hypocrisy. Lurid, funny and unexpectedly vu

Countess Irina Karlstein moves through an island landscape with a hunger she cannot escape. Those drawn to her become victims; the poet who recognises her loneliness offers the possibility of something more dangerous than feeding: intimacy.Lina Romay gives Jesús Franco’s vampire reverie its strange mixture of command and vulnerability. Drifting camera movements, misty locations and Daniel White’s score suspend the story between erotic fantasy and a melancholy dream. A film less interested in the
tmdb_overview: A mute noblewoman's vampiric heritage compels her to drain the life force from all of her lovers.

synopsis: A dancer wakes from dreams of murder convinced that she may have committed the crimes herself. Inside a remote villa, reassurance only makes things stranger: every lover, doctor and memory seems to have another purpose.Diana Lorys gives Jesús Franco’s elusive thriller a fragile centre as the story drifts between gaslighting, desire and nightmare. Mirrors, bedrooms and unstable recollections take the place of firm ground. Its pleasure lies in that disorientation: an intimate psychological mystery
tmdb_overview: Diana Lorys, Collette Jack and Soledad Miranda star in this sexy thriller about two alluring dancers, Cincia and Anne, who embark on an erotically charged partnership. But when Anne starts to have nightmares that feature her as a murderous killer, she begins to lose her grip on reality. Or is reality merely rearing its ugly head in her dreams? She's determined find out what's causing this turmoil before something deadly happens.

synopsis: Agent 00 has a kidnapped scientist to rescue, an evil mastermind to stop and a gadget for almost every occasion. The odds are absurd. Weng Weng treats them as an invitation.Eddie Nicart’s Filipino spy adventure gives its star a full arsenal of rooftop escapes, martial-arts encounters and Bond-style ingenuity. What makes it irresistible is the commitment: the film plays its impossible mission with an infectious mixture of swagger and invention. A scrappy international cult favourite powered by a
tmdb_overview: Mr. Giant has kidnapped the brilliant Dr. Van Kohler and is planning to use the Doctor's invention, the N-bomb, to hold the world hostage. The only one who can foil Mr. Giant's evil scheme is Agent 00, a 3-foot-tall filipino martial arts master, expert marksman, top-class romancer and all-around superspy. Can Agent 00 rescue Dr. Kohler before it's too late?

synopsis: STAY tells the story of an artist (The Artist) sentenced to do time in The Curfew Tower, with only a handheld puppet of Elvis (Puppet Elvis) as company. While doing time, The Artist is expected to write the second-best song he has ever written. And this song is for the Ghost of Elvis and is to be performed at The 25 Comeback Special. In reality The Artist is just trying to escape the gathering storm clouds of his inevitable midlife crisis. That, and the reality of being a bad father. The only di

Two teenagers escape a psychiatric hospital and turn the streets of New York into their stage. As the Sleez Sisters, Pamela and Nicky invent a noisy new identity that parents, police and respectable society cannot comfortably contain.Trini Alvarado and Robin Johnson give Allan Moyle’s cult film its bruised, rebellious heart. A tremendous punk and new-wave soundtrack propels a vision of friendship as self-invention, against a Midtown that has since disappeared. Ragged, romantic and fiercely attac
tmdb_overview: When a 13-year-old girl befriends a defiant antisocial child of the streets, the mismatched runaways set off to the Big Apple to find their own adventure.

movie_title: VALERIE AND HER WEEK OF WONDERS
movie_title_en: VALERIE AND HER WEEK OF WONDERS
synopsis: A pair of enchanted earrings offers Valerie protection as her village fills with vampires, corrupt holy men and relatives who will not stay in the same shape. Growing up here means discovering that familiar faces can become the strangest masks.Jaromil Jireš makes a fairy tale from the collision of innocence, fear and awakening. Jan Curík’s luminous images and Luboš Fišer’s haunting score give the Czech New Wave fantasy the vividness of a half-remembered dream. Beautiful and deeply uncanny, it dr
tmdb_title: Valerie and Her Week of Wonders
tmdb_overview: Valerie, a Czechoslovakian teenager living with her grandmother, is blossoming into womanhood, but that transformation proves secondary to the effects she experiences when she puts on a pair of magic earrings. Now seeing the world around her in a different light, Valerie must endure her sexual awakening while attempting to discern reality from fantasy as she encounters lecherous priest Gracian, a vampire-like stranger and otherworldly carnival folk.

movie_title: DONT LOOK BACK + BOB DYLAN CONCERT FOOTAGE
movie_title_en: DONT LOOK BACK + BOB DYLAN CONCERT FOOTAGE
synopsis: Dylan on stage is only half the story. In hotel rooms, backstage corridors and combative interviews during his 1965 British tour, he is inventing—and resisting—the public figure everyone wants him to become.D. A. Pennebaker’s camera catches the wit, the cruelty, the boredom and the sudden electricity without a narrator telling us what to think. From the cue cards of “Subterranean Homesick Blues” to performances alive with concentration, this landmark music documentary puts you in the room at the
tmdb_overview: In this wildly entertaining vision of one of the twentieth century’s greatest artists, Bob Dylan is surrounded by teen fans, gets into heated philosophical jousts with journalists, and kicks back with fellow musicians Joan Baez, Donovan, and Alan Price.

movie_title_en: PAT GARRETT AND BILLY THE KID + BOB DYLAN CONCERT FOOTAGE
synopsis: Pat Garrett takes a badge and a job: kill the friend who represents the life he has left behind. Billy the Kid keeps moving, even as the West is being bought, fenced and brought to heel around him.James Coburn and Kris Kristofferson give Sam Peckinpah’s elegiac western its weathered soul. Bob Dylan drifts through as Alias and supplies songs that seem to mourn the landscape itself. Less a chase than a long farewell, this is a film about friendship becoming history—and the terrible price of choosi
tmdb_overview: Pat Garrett is hired as a lawman on behalf of a group of wealthy New Mexico cattle barons to bring down his old friend Billy the Kid.

synopsis: Ocho Inoshika has the men who killed her father in her sights. A pickpocket, gambler and swordswoman moving through Meiji-era Tokyo, she finds her revenge tangled with yakuza interests, corrupt politicians and a British spy.Reiko Ike commands Norifumi Suzuki’s pinky-violence landmark with an extraordinary combination of stillness and explosive force. Christina Lindberg adds another volatile presence to its political intrigue and pop-art spectacle. Snow, tattoos, blades and delirious colour turn

Tetsu wants to leave the yakuza behind. Loyalty keeps dragging him back. Sent away from Tokyo, he becomes a wandering target in a gangster story that seems to shed another piece of realism with every mile.Seijun Suzuki turns a studio assignment into pure pop-art invention: snowbound pursuits, neon nightclubs, startling colour and a final space almost abstract enough to swallow the actors. Tetsuya Watari’s cool presence and recurring theme song hold the delirium together. A crime film that dances
tmdb_overview: After yakuza boss Kurata dissolves his own criminal empire, a rival kingpin offers a position to Kurata's top operative, Tetsuya "Phoenix Tetsu" Hondo. When the fiercely loyal Tetsu declines, Otsuka taps unstoppable Tatsuzo the "Viper", a ruthless gun-for-hire, to assassinate him. As the Viper trails his target through the countryside, the agile Phoenix Tetsu grows concerned that one of his former associates has betrayed him.

synopsis: A gallery owner’s private photographs draw a young woman into a world where looking is never innocent. Fascination becomes an experiment in control, and the distance between observer and captive grows dangerously small.Henri-Georges Clouzot’s final film trades the monochrome menace of DIABOLIQUE for optical art, saturated colour and fractured reflections. The images are seductive precisely because they are traps. A feverish study of voyeurism and obsession from a master of suspense discovering n
tmdb_overview: Gallery director Stanislas bolsters the development of modern art with his collection of surprising works. His newest acquisition is a sculpture by Gilbert, whose wife Josée is captivated by Stanislas. But unbeknownst to her, Stanislas is amassing photographs of a very perverse, disturbed nature.

synopsis: Alice receives an obscene phone call so extraordinary that she falls in love with the caller. Finding him means crossing a New York populated by voyeurs, fantasists and people with rather specialised ideas about communication.Nelson Lyon’s lost countercultural comedy makes sexploitation collide with pop art, media satire and underground filmmaking. Stark monochrome photography and a restless parade of eccentrics turn the romantic quest into something wonderfully unstable. Dirty jokes become ques
tmdb_overview: A sexually voracious young woman receives a dirty phone call from a stranger; so satisfied by the experience, she sets out to find him somewhere in New York City.

synopsis: White Girl and Cyclona break out of detention and head for Mexico, trusting a promise of sanctuary that sounds suspiciously like another trap. Their trail of bad decisions turns into a filthy, violent rewrite of HANSEL AND GRETEL.Natasha Lyonne and María Celedonio make an explosive double act in Matthew Bright’s grotesque fugitive fairy tale, with Vincent Gallo waiting at the far end of the road. Beneath its gleefully offensive surfaces is a world that keeps turning vulnerable people into predat
tmdb_title: Freeway II: Confessions of a Trickbaby
tmdb_original_title: Freeway II: Confessions of a Trickbaby
tmdb_overview: A twisted teenage prostitute and an equally deranged vicious killer manage to escape from the pen and embark on a non-stop orgy of violence and debauchery, all while hoping to make it across the border into Mexico in order to seek refuge with the mysterious Sister Gomez.

synopsis: Wanda gives up custody of her children and drifts through Pennsylvania’s coal country with no plan that will survive the day. A petty criminal offers her a place beside him, but belonging comes with another set of orders.Barbara Loden wrote, directed and stars in this extraordinary independent film, finding immense emotional force in pauses, uncertain gestures and shabby rooms. The camera grants attention to a woman other stories would hurry past. Unsentimental and profoundly humane, WANDA asks
tmdb_overview: After a string of abusive relationships, Wanda abandons her family and seeks solace in the company of a petty criminal.

synopsis: Raised by a magician, a young man inherits a duty stranger than any ordinary family legacy: guarding La Goulve, the Daughter of the Golem. When occult power meets his desires, the boundary between the everyday and the supernatural begins to give way.Mario Mercier and Bepi Fontana’s elusive French fantasy is a discovery from the wilder edges of seventies occult cinema. Sorcery, desire and the Golem legend make an unusual combination, promising a detour from familiar vampire and witchcraft stories
tmdb_overview: Axel, the magician, raises a boy into adulthood. When Axel dies, it's the young man - son of a murderer, and well tutored by a magician - to keep on the tradition of guarding the Daughter of the Golem.

synopsis: After inheriting a century-old moustache from an eccentric great-aunt, David Bramwell follows the trail of its former owner through séances, spiritualist churches, Brighton basement clubs and an increasingly strange occult odyssey.Blending filmed monologue, memoir and psychedelic folklore, this funny and affecting modern fireside tale won a Special Mention Audience Award at CINECITY 2025. The screening is followed by an on-stage Q&A.Runtime:97minsCertificate:18Thursday19/11Bar5:45pmFilm6:15pmDig
tmdb_overview: The story of a mysterious inheritance, seances, psychedelics and Brighton’s 1990s alt-cabaret scene is woven together with inimitable charm, writer David Bramwell recalls his UK odyssey to find the origins of the moustache inherited from Great Aunt Sylia. He encounters the occult, mind altering drugs and a cabaret of misfits including Hippy Lily, Dave Suit and the enigmatic Drako Oho Zarhazar.

synopsis: Goose wants out of gang life. The street has other plans. When his attempt to leave ends in devastating violence, he is pulled back into a world where loyalty is temporary and revenge is the only reliable currency.Jim Van Bebber writes, directs and hurls himself into this handmade Dayton action nightmare. Rooftops, graveyards and derelict buildings become an arena for bone-rattling stunts and feral physical commitment. Shot with the resourcefulness of punk cinema and the ambition of a martial-ar
tmdb_overview: Goose leaves the gang life behind after pleas from his girlfriend.  But it isn't long before he's pulled back into the world of violence.

synopsis: A reporter sees a murder through a window. By the time the police arrive, the evidence has vanished. Split screens, fractured viewpoints and Bernard Herrmann’s agitated score make certainty increasingly impossible, while Margot Kidder gives the mystery its unnerving human face. A wickedly inventive early

Three roommates are tired of disappointing men and dead-end routines. Their pursuit of pleasure becomes a cheerfully unruly chain of fantasies, misunderstandings and encounters, all filtered through Doris Wishman’s gloriously peculiar comic imagination.A late-career return from one of American exploitation cinema’s great independents, DILDO HEAVEN makes eccentric framing, mismatched voices and homemade ingenuity part of its language. synopsis: The story of a courageous girl, Prue McKeel, on a desperate mission to rescue her baby brother from a forbidden forest filled with enchanted creatures, endearing allies, and formidable adversaries. Her journey unfolds into a spectacular, high-stakes adventure where the fate of an entire hidden world hangs in the balance.
tmdb_overview: After her baby brother is abducted by a murder of crows, Prue and her classmate Curtis stumble upon a secret world in the midst of violent upheaval—a world full of warring creatures, peaceable mystics, and powerful figures with dark intentions. synopsis: CIA agents Chris (John Malkovich) and Lee (Sam Rockwell) are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ (Steve Buscemi). synopsis:
DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain.
 
“Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.
tmdb_overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

movie_title: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House
movie_title_en: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House
synopsis:
The ghostly residents of Button House are adjusting to life without Alison and Mike, but when protesters disrupt the construction of the planned hotel, the ghosts need to find a way to reach their living friends.

When an amateur séance goes awry, Julian seizes the opportunity to leave the grounds in the body of teenage ghost hunter Jack. Whilst Julian experiences the outside world for the first time in decades, Jack gets a crash course in the afterlife from the ghosts. But what was supposed to be a temporary switch soon reveals the risk of permanent consequences…

synopsis:
DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain.
 
“Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.
tmdb_overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

movie_title: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House
movie_title_en: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House
synopsis:
The ghostly residents of Button House are adjusting to life without Alison and Mike, but when protesters disrupt the construction of the planned hotel, the ghosts need to find a way to reach their living friends.

When an amateur séance goes awry, Julian seizes the opportunity to leave the grounds in the body of teenage ghost hunter Jack. Whilst Julian experiences the outside world for the first time in decades, Jack gets a crash course in the afterlife from the ghosts. But what was supposed to be a temporary switch soon reveals the risk of permanent consequences…

synopsis:
DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain.
 
“Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.
tmdb_overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

synopsis:
An enduring masterpiece of cinema starring Academy Award-winner Vanessa Redgrave and Oliver Reed, Ken Russell's The Devils is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption - and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. 

Assembled from the original camera negative, this new 4K restoration presents Ken Russell's definitive vision of The Devils by referencing the edit he privately constructed in 2004. Ken Russell's The Devils is the uncut and unfiltered theatrical experience that Russell always envisioned - and the first time the film will be presented restored and in 4k.

Step into the shadows and join us After Dark at Everyman Broadgate. This week, we're switching off the colour and hitting the streets of Paris with Mathieu Kassovitz's violently powerful and provocative La Haine.

When a young Arab is arrested and beaten unconscious by police, a riot erupts in the notoriously violent suburbs outside of Paris. Three of the victim's peers, Vinz (Vincent Cassel), Said (Said Taghmaoui) and Hubert (Hubert Koundé), wander aimlessly about their home turf in the aftermath of the violence as they try to come to grips with their outrage over the brutal incident. After one of the men finds a police officer's discarded weapon, their night seems poised to take a bleak turn.

While celebrating their last night together, Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali, packed with magical and mythological creatures they grew up hearing stories about from their Filipino families. 

Some of these figures will become friends, some foes. Joined by well-meaning-but- hapless weredog Raww (Dave Franco) and a small-but-mighty pack of pals, Jo and Raissa must face The Dreaded Manananggal (Tony winning icon Lea Salonga), the most feared creature on the island. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa will race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

tmdb_overview: After her baby brother is abducted by a murder of crows, Prue and her classmate Curtis stumble upon a secret world in the midst of violent upheaval—a world full of warring creatures, peaceable mystics, and powerful figures with dark intentions. And what begins as a rescue mission becomes something much greater as the two find themselves entwined in a struggle for the very freedom of this wilderness—a wilderness the locals call Wildwood

synopsis:
An enduring masterpiece of cinema starring Academy Award-winner Vanessa Redgrave and Oliver Reed, Ken Russell's The Devils is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption - and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. 

Assembled from the original camera negative, this new 4K restoration presents Ken Russell's definitive vision of The Devils by referencing the edit he privately constructed in 2004. Ken Russell's The Devils is the uncut and unfiltered theatrical experience that Russell always envisioned - and the first time the film will be presented restored and in 4k.

synopsis:
A slightly dimwitted amateur boxer from Philadelphia's tough neighborhood gets a surprise shot at fighting for the heavyweight championship, while at the same time he finds love in the arms of a shy, reclusive girl who works in the local pet store.

Screening on Sundays and Wednesdays as part of our Throwback Season, where we revisit classics. Each ticket to these showtimes includes complimentary popcorn and a drink.
tmdb_overview: Rocky Balboa is a Philadelphia club fighter who seems to be going nowhere. But when a stroke of fate puts him in the ring with a world heavyweight champion, Rocky knows that it's his one shot at the big time — a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to go the distance and come out a winner!

movie_title: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House
movie_title_en: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House
synopsis:
The ghostly residents of Button House are adjusting to life without Alison and Mike, but when protesters disrupt the construction of the planned hotel, the ghosts need to find a way to reach their living friends.

When an amateur séance goes awry, Julian seizes the opportunity to leave the grounds in the body of teenage ghost hunter Jack. Whilst Julian experiences the outside world for the first time in decades, Jack gets a crash course in the afterlife from the ghosts. But what was supposed to be a temporary switch soon reveals the risk of permanent consequences…

synopsis:
DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain.
 
“Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.
tmdb_overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother (Amy Adams), and they’ve suffered great loss, but Klara’s innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie’s complicated world.
tmdb_overview: An Artificial Friend named Klara finds a deep bond with a troubled young girl, bringing light and hope to a grieving family through her unwavering devotion and innocent wonder.

movie_title: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House
movie_title_en: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House
synopsis:
The ghostly residents of Button House are adjusting to life without Alison and Mike, but when protesters disrupt the construction of the planned hotel, the ghosts need to find a way to reach their living friends.

When an amateur séance goes awry, Julian seizes the opportunity to leave the grounds in the body of teenage ghost hunter Jack. Whilst Julian experiences the outside world for the first time in decades, Jack gets a crash course in the afterlife from the ghosts. But what was supposed to be a temporary switch soon reveals the risk of permanent consequences…
tmdb_title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
tmdb_original_title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
tmdb_overview: It's a matter of life and death for Alison, Mike, Mia and the Ghosts.

synopsis: Struggling writer Lowen Ashleigh is hired as a ghostwriter for renowned author Verity Crawford under mysterious circumstances, but her assignment takes a dark turn after discovering chilling autobiographical notes. synopsis: CIA agents Chris (John Malkovich) and Lee (Sam Rockwell) are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ (Steve Buscemi). DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain.
 
“Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.
tmdb_overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

Assembled from the original camera negative, this new 4K restoration presents Ken Russell's definitive vision of The Devils by referencing the edit he privately constructed in 2004. Ken Russell's The Devils is the uncut and unfiltered theatrical experience that Russell always envisioned - and the first time the film will be presented restored and in 4k.

synopsis: CIA agents Chris (John Malkovich) and Lee (Sam Rockwell) are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ (Steve Buscemi). synopsis: The story of a courageous girl, Prue McKeel, on a desperate mission to rescue her baby brother from a forbidden forest filled with enchanted creatures, endearing allies, and formidable adversaries. Her journey unfolds into a spectacular, high-stakes adventure where the fate of an entire hidden world hangs in the balance.
tmdb_overview: After her baby brother is abducted by a murder of crows, Prue and her classmate Curtis stumble upon a secret world in the midst of violent upheaval—a world full of warring creatures, peaceable mystics, and powerful figures with dark intentions. And what begins as a rescue mission becomes something much greater as the two find themselves entwined in a struggle for the very freedom of this wilderness—a wilderness the locals call Wildwood

movie_title: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House
movie_title_en: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House
synopsis:
The ghostly residents of Button House are adjusting to life without Alison and Mike, but when protesters disrupt the construction of the planned hotel, the ghosts need to find a way to reach their living friends.

When an amateur séance goes awry, Julian seizes the opportunity to leave the grounds in the body of teenage ghost hunter Jack. Whilst Julian experiences the outside world for the first time in decades, Jack gets a crash course in the afterlife from the ghosts. But what was supposed to be a temporary switch soon reveals the risk of permanent consequences…

synopsis: Based on the bestselling novel from Nobel Prize-winner Kazuo Ishiguro and written and directed by Academy-Award® winner Taika Waititi (Jojo Rabbit), Klara and the Sun introduces audiences to Klara (Jenna Ortega), an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home. When Klara meets Josie (Mia Tharia), each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother (Amy Adams), and they’ve suffered great loss, but Klara’s innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie’s complicated world.
tmdb_overview: An Artificial Friend named Klara finds a deep bond with a troubled young girl, bringing light and hope to a grieving family through her unwavering devotion and innocent wonder.

movie_title: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House
movie_title_en: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House
synopsis:
The ghostly residents of Button House are adjusting to life without Alison and Mike, but when protesters disrupt the construction of the planned hotel, the ghosts need to find a way to reach their living friends.

When an amateur séance goes awry, Julian seizes the opportunity to leave the grounds in the body of teenage ghost hunter Jack. Whilst Julian experiences the outside world for the first time in decades, Jack gets a crash course in the afterlife from the ghosts. But what was supposed to be a temporary switch soon reveals the risk of permanent consequences…

movie_title: When Harry Met Sally presented by The Rhubarb Society + RomCom Quiz
movie_title_en: When Harry Met Sally presented by The Rhubarb Society + RomCom Quiz
synopsis:
Spend an Autumnal evening at Everyman at The Whiteley with The Rhubarb Society, whilst we cosy up to watch the rom-com classic, ‘When Harry Met Sally’. In honour of the crisp Autumnal mornings and changing colours of the trees, we thought there was no better choice to usher in our favourite season. In honour of the legendary Nora Ephron, we will be holding a rom-com film quiz for members in the cinema ahead of the screening. 
 
Alongside fabulously curated gifting for all attendees, there will be some friendly competition, amazing prizes to be won and a burning desire to invest in a chunky roll neck ASAP. Expect Meg Ryan, Billy Crystal, New York in its finest season, and one of cinema’s most infamous lunch orders.

We’ll have what she’s having.

The result is the ultimate underdog story behind the ultimate underdog movie.

synopsis:
DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain.
 
“Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.
tmdb_overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

synopsis:
The ghostly residents of Button House are adjusting to life without Alison and Mike, but when protesters disrupt the construction of the planned hotel, the ghosts need to find a way to reach their living friends.

When an amateur séance goes awry, Julian seizes the opportunity to leave the grounds in the body of teenage ghost hunter Jack. Whilst Julian experiences the outside world for the first time in decades, Jack gets a crash course in the afterlife from the ghosts. But what was supposed to be a temporary switch soon reveals the risk of permanent consequences…

synopsis: Based on the bestselling novel from Nobel Prize-winner Kazuo Ishiguro and written and directed by Academy-Award® winner Taika Waititi (Jojo Rabbit), Klara and the Sun introduces audiences to Klara (Jenna Ortega), an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home. When Klara meets Josie (Mia Tharia), each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother (Amy Adams), and they’ve suffered great loss, but Klara’s innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie’s complicated world.
tmdb_overview: An Artificial Friend named Klara finds a deep bond with a troubled young girl, bringing light and hope to a grieving family through her unwavering devotion and innocent wonder.

synopsis:
Josh O’Connor (The Crown; Challengers) leads the cast in this searing revival of Clifford Odets’ knockout American classic. 

1930s New York, at the height of the Depression. Joe Bonaparte is a gifted young violinist with a future in music, until a chance at fame and fortune lures him into the brutal world of professional boxing. He must confront what he’s willing to sacrifice, who he’s willing to become and how to find his place in a world that demands he choose a side. 

Brought to life with a live string quartet and filmed live from the Almeida Theatre. Olivier Award-winner Sam Yates (Vanya) directs this propulsive drama exploring ambition, identity, and the high price of success.  

Content Warning: This production includes flashing lights, which may impact customers with photosensitive epilepsy.

synopsis:
DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain.
 
“Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.
tmdb_overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

synopsis:
An enduring masterpiece of cinema starring Academy Award-winner Vanessa Redgrave and Oliver Reed, Ken Russell's The Devils is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption - and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. 

Assembled from the original camera negative, this new 4K restoration presents Ken Russell's definitive vision of The Devils by referencing the edit he privately constructed in 2004. Ken Russell's The Devils is the uncut and unfiltered theatrical experience that Russell always envisioned - and the first time the film will be presented restored and in 4k.

Based on the bestselling novel from Nobel Prize-winner Kazuo Ishiguro and written and directed by Academy-Award® winner Taika Waititi (Jojo Rabbit), Klara and the Sun introduces audiences to Klara (Jenna Ortega), an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home. When Klara meets Josie (Mia Tharia), each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother (Amy Adams), and they’ve suffered great loss, but Klara’s innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie’s complicated world.
tmdb_overview: An Artificial Friend named Klara finds a deep bond with a troubled young girl, bringing light and hope to a grieving family through her unwavering devotion and innocent wonder.

synopsis:
In a remote Spanish town, the free-spirited Carmen declares that any man she loves should beware. But even she is unprepared for what happens when she decides to seduce police officer Don José. Though initially uninterested in Carmen’s charms, Don José – against the wishes of his mother and of Micaëla, the woman who loves him – soon abandons his respectable career for a life of danger with Carmen. 

But she soon grows weary of Don José's possessiveness, longing to return to a life of independence. When Carmen turns her attention to the celebrated toreador Escamillo, Don José’s jealousy and despair threaten to violently erupt.

movie_title_en: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House
synopsis:
The ghostly residents of Button House are adjusting to life without Alison and Mike, but when protesters disrupt the construction of the planned hotel, the ghosts need to find a way to reach their living friends.

When an amateur séance goes awry, Julian seizes the opportunity to leave the grounds in the body of teenage ghost hunter Jack. Whilst Julian experiences the outside world for the first time in decades, Jack gets a crash course in the afterlife from the ghosts. But what was supposed to be a temporary switch soon reveals the risk of permanent consequences…

synopsis:
An enduring masterpiece of cinema starring Academy Award-winner Vanessa Redgrave and Oliver Reed, Ken Russell's The Devils is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption - and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. 

Assembled from the original camera negative, this new 4K restoration presents Ken Russell's definitive vision of The Devils by referencing the edit he privately constructed in 2004. Ken Russell's The Devils is the uncut and unfiltered theatrical experience that Russell always envisioned - and the first time the film will be presented restored and in 4k.

synopsis:
DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

This is 'Part 1' of two in the De Gaulle series.

synopsis:
An enduring masterpiece of cinema starring Academy Award-winner Vanessa Redgrave and Oliver Reed, Ken Russell's The Devils is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption - and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. 

Assembled from the original camera negative, this new 4K restoration presents Ken Russell's definitive vision of The Devils by referencing the edit he privately constructed in 2004. Ken Russell's The Devils is the uncut and unfiltered theatrical experience that Russell always envisioned - and the first time the film will be presented restored and in 4k.

DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain.
 
“Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.
tmdb_overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

Her journey unfolds into a spectacular, high-stakes adventure where the fate of an entire hidden world hangs in the balance.
tmdb_overview: After her baby brother is abducted by a murder of crows, Prue and her classmate Curtis stumble upon a secret world in the midst of violent upheaval—a world full of warring creatures, peaceable mystics, and powerful figures with dark intentions. synopsis:
The ghostly residents of Button House are adjusting to life without Alison and Mike, but when protesters disrupt the construction of the planned hotel, the ghosts need to find a way to reach their living friends.

When an amateur séance goes awry, Julian seizes the opportunity to leave the grounds in the body of teenage ghost hunter Jack. Whilst Julian experiences the outside world for the first time in decades, Jack gets a crash course in the afterlife from the ghosts. But what was supposed to be a temporary switch soon reveals the risk of permanent consequences…

synopsis:
DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain.
 
“Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.
tmdb_overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

movie_title: Toddler Club: Zog + The Snail & the Whale
movie_title_en: Toddler Club: Zog + The Snail & the Whale
synopsis:
Join us for a Toddler Club double-bill, featuring Julia Donaldson's famous children's tales on the big screen!

ZOG
An accident-prone dragon is desperate to impress his teacher at Dragon School while becoming friends with a powerful princess.

THE SNAIL & THE WHALE
A tiny snail sets out to see the world and hitches a ride on the tail of a friendly humpback whale. A joyous, empowering story about the world's natural wonders and discovering that you can make a difference, no matter how small you are.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

synopsis:
A Norwegian woman (Renate Reinsve) and her devout Romanian husband (Sebastian Stan) relocate with their five children to a remote coastal town. As their teenagers grow closer to a neighbouring family, tensions begin to escalate when their tight-knit new community starts to question their rigid beliefs. Soon, the parents are forced to counter accusations that could tear their household apart – and battle a system that blurs the line between concern and prejudice.

Captivatingly led by Academy Award nominees Sebastian Stan and Renate Reinsve, Cristian Mungiu’s Palme d’Or winner FJORD delivers a gripping study of a family under scrutiny.
tmdb_overview: Following the deaths of Mihai's parents, Mihai and Lisbeth Gheorghiu leave their life behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbeth's family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth gives them hope for a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghiu family’s young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.

synopsis:
Step into the shadows and join us After Dark at Everyman Broadgate. This week, we're diving into the dark recesses of desire, obsession, and paraphilia with Michael Haneke's erotic psychological drama, The Piano Teacher.

Erika Kohut is a piano teacher at the Vienna Conservatory, a prestigious music school in Vienna. In her early forties and single, she lives with her overprotective and controlling mother in a hermetically sealed world of love-hate and dependency, where there is no room for men. Her sex life consists of voyeurism and masochistic self-injury. Lonely and alienated, Erika finds solace by visiting sex shops and experimenting with masochism. 

At a recital, she befriends Walter, a handsome young man, whom she seduces and with whom she begins an illicit affair. As Erika slowly drifts closer to the brink of emotional disorder, she uses the love-stricken Walter to explore her darkest sadomasochistic fantasies, which eventually lead to her undoing.

movie_title: Toddler Club: Festive Fun with Peppa
movie_title_en: Toddler Club: Festive Fun with Peppa
synopsis:
Join Peppa Pig and her family at the cinema for a festive big-screen experience as they celebrate Evie’s first Christmas! Share in the excitement of the holidays as the family of five reflect on treasured festive memories. From snowy adventures and holiday plays to decorating the tree, this hour-long cinema experience brings together 7 classic festive-themed Peppa Pig episodes and 4 brand-new songs that little ones can dance and sing along to. 

Filled with laughter, music and heartwarming moments, this special cinema experience is the perfect family day out during the holiday season. So grab your hats, scarves and gloves and enjoy the holiday magic along with your favourite piggies at the Festive Fun with Peppa Cinema Experience!

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.
